description: Arrêts, itinéraires et horaires théoriques des réseaux de transport des membres de JVMALIN is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by JVMALIN. JVMALIN est un système d'informations multimodales regroupant l'offre mobilité des autorités organisatrices suivantes: Agglomération Montargoise et rives du Loing, Chartres Métropole, Communauté d'Agglomération Châteauroux Métropole, Communauté d'Agglomération de Blois Agglopolys, Communauté d'Agglomération du Pays de Dreux, Communauté d'Agglomération Territoire Vendômois, Communauté de communes du Pays d'Issoudun, Orléans Métropole, Syndicat des Mobilités de Touraine, Syndicat Mixte ... Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are jvmalin, bus, Cars, Rémi. The portal shows 2 records. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
